mapper.sql: id, order_id, order_no, pay_method, transaction_no, pay_amount, pay_status, pay_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_log (id, order_id, order_no, pay_method, transaction_no, pay_amount, pay_status, pay_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{payMethod}, #{transactionNo}, #{payAmount}, #{payStatus}, #{payTime}, #{expireTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_log SET pay_status = #{payStatus}, transaction_no = #{transactionNo}, pay_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
